name: PD 446 was established by Ordinance No. 22781, passed by the Dallas City Council on June 12,
source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 446 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-446.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 446 was established by Ordinance No. 22781, passed by the Dallas City Council on June 12, 1996. Ordinance No. 22781 amended Ordinance No. 19455, Chapter 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 19455; 22781; 26042)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-446.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 446 is established on property generally located along both sides of Carroll Avenue, between Munger Avenue and Ross Avenue. The size of PD 446 is approximately 5.435 acres. (Ord. Nos. 22781; 26042)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-446.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered to be a nonresidential zoning district. (Ord. Nos. 22781; 26042)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-446.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

Development and use of the Property must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 446A). In the event of a conflict between the provisions of this article and the development plan, the provisions of this article control. (Ord. Nos. 22781; 26042)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-446.105. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

The only uses permitted are a public school and surface parking for the public school use located on Tract I. (Ord. Nos. 22781; 26042)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-446.106. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(Note: The yard, lot, and space regulations in this section must be read together with the yard, lot, and space regulations contained in Division 51A-4.400. In the event of conflict between this section and Division 51A-4.400, this section controls.)

(a) Front yard.

(1) Tract I. Minimum front yard on Ross Avenue is 10 feet; minimum front yard on North Carroll Avenue is 15 feet; and minimum front yard on Munger Avenue is 10 feet.

(2) Tract II. Minimum front yard on North Carroll Avenue is five feet. Minimum front yard on Roseland Avenue is three feet.

(3) Tract III. Minimum front yard on North Carroll Avenue and on Roseland Avenue is 11 feet.

(b) Side and rear yard.

(1) Tract I. Minimum side yard on Ross Avenue and on Munger Avenue is seven feet. No minimum rear yard.

(2) Tract II. Minimum side yard on North Carroll Avenue is four feet, and minimum side yard on Roseland Avenue is one foot. No minimum rear yard.

(3) Tract III. Minimum side yard on North Carroll Avenue and on Roseland Avenue is 11 feet. No minimum rear yard.

(c) Floor area. Maximum permitted floor area is 99,800 square feet.

(d) Height. Maximum structure height is 60 feet.

(e) Lot coverage.

(1) Maximum lot coverage is 29 percent.

(2) Surface parking lots and underground parking structures are not included in lot coverage calculations.

(f) Lot size. No minimum lot size.

(g) Stories. Maximum number of stories is two. (Ord. Nos. 22781; 26042)

sections.title: Roadway Improvements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-446.107. ROADWAY IMPROVEMENTS.

Prior to the issuance of a certificate of occupancy for a public school, the pavement width along that portion of Tract I that fronts on Carroll Avenue and Munger Avenue must be a minimum of 36 feet. (Ord. Nos. 22781; 26042)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-446.108. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

(a) Off-street parking for the public school must be provided and located on Tracts I, II, and III, as shown on the development plan.

(b) All off-street parking areas on Tracts II and III must be illuminated as follows:

(1) Lighting must be provided when the parking lots are in use.

(2) Light sources must be indirect, diffused, or shielded-type fixtures, installed to reduce glare and the consequent interference with boundary streets. Bare bulbs or strings of lamps are prohibited.

(3) The intensity of the lighting on the area identified must average at least two footcandles, initial measurement, and at least one footcandle on a maintained basis.

(4) The intensity of the lighting must be a minimum at any point of at least 0.6 footcandle initial, and at least 0.3 footcandle maintained or one-third of the average for the lighted area, whichever is greater.

(c) All access points to Tracts II and III, as shown on the development plan, must be gated and locked when the off-street parking areas on Tracts II and III are not in use to provide off-street parking for the public school. (Ord. Nos. 22781; 26042)

sections.title: Fencing
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-446.109. FENCING.

Prior to the issuance of a certificate of occupancy for a public school use, fencing must be provided as shown on the development plan. The portion of the fence located along the northeastern and northwestern boundary lines of Tract II and along the northeastern and southeastern boundary lines of Tract III must be a minimum six-foot solid screening fence. (Ord. Nos. 22781; 26042)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-446.110. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. Nos. 22781; 26042)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-446.111. LANDSCAPING.

(a) Prior to the issuance of a certificate of occupancy, landscaping must be provided as shown on the landscape plan (Exhibit 446B). Plant material must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition.

(b) Prior to the issuance of a certificate of occupancy and except as provided in (c) below, tree preservation criteria must be met as outlined in Division 51A-10.130.

(c) For purposes of this section, tree replacement is permitted on any Dallas Independent School District site. Tree replacement must be completed within six months of issuance of a building permit for this Property. (Ord. Nos. 22781; 26042)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-446.112. SIGNS.

Signs must comply with the provisions for business zoning districts contained in Article VII. (Ord. Nos. 22781; 26042)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-446.113. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) The entire Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(b) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 22781; 26042)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-446.114. PAVING.

All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 22781; 26042)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-446.115. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 22781; 26042)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-446.116. ZONING MAP.

PD 446 is located on Zoning Map No. I-8. (Ord. Nos. 22781; 26042)
